analysis_options.observation: Per case: full per-space projection (index/name/type/addrsize/wordsize/endian/shortcut/delay/deadcodedelay/highest/pointerLowerBound/pointerUpperBound/minimumPointerSize/refcount + 11 flag predicates), numSpaces, cached-slot contents, ordered getNextSpaceInOrder walks, exact LowlevelError messages on every rejection path, spacebase baseloc/baseOrig after truncation with endian-dependent offset adjustment, and copySpaces shared-handle refcount
analysis_options.normalization: No normalization: identical observation strings printed by both sides; refcount read via test-only private access on the C++ side and a read-only accessor on the Rust side

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases
cases: canonical_insert_order: production insert order with dynamic index allocation; full projection of all eight canonical spaces incl. calcScaleMask bounds, flag predicates, shortcut chars, and cached slot wiring

rejection_paths: duplicate id, duplicate name (with partial baselist growth to index+1 before rejection), type-name mismatch, mis-indexed const and OTHER spaces, duplicate ConstantSpace; numSpaces/lookups/walk after failures
hole_fill_iteration: dead baselist holes are skipped by getNextSpaceInOrder and numSpaces, then a hole is filled by a late insert and re-walked; end sentinel terminates the walk
shortcut_collision: type-based default chars (#/ %/s/u/j/i/f/r/o), first-name-char defaults, uppercase folding, collision advance, and shortcut-table lookups
shortcut_z_reuse: 26 occupied letters force the >26 collision path; the space reuses 'z' while getSpaceByShortcut('z') still returns the older space

projection_wordsize_endian_flags: wordsize-scaled highest and pointer bounds, little/big endian, addressToByte/byteToAddress conversions, wrapOffset including modulo wrap, near-pointer marking, reverse justification, infer-pointer bounds, deadcode delay, truncateSpace recompute, overlay construction marking the base overlaybase, and manager truncateSpace name resolution errors

spacebase_pointer_bridge: addSpacebasePointer idempotence and conflict rejection, baseloc/baseOrig with endian-dependent truncation offset adjustment (big-endian shifts up, little-endian keeps), growth direction, contain link, and missing-register errors
copy_spaces_refcount: copySpaces shares handles (refcount 2 on both managers), reproduces cached slots, default code/data spaces and the ordered walk, and the copied name table rejects duplicates

observation_schema.order: getNextSpaceInOrder walks; shortcut table point lookups

build.rust_comparand: A SHA-256-pinned full Rust crate snapshot is materialized from the pinned Rugra Git base with only src/space.rs and src/translate.rs overlaid; every registry archive is checked against Cargo.lock, safely expanded to a private vendor tree, and used through a private CARGO_HOME
build.environment_policy: Runner re-executes from an open file descriptor under an empty environment, verifies fixed toolchain/oracle/base identities, snapshots every mutable input, rebuilds the oracle archive, runs Cargo locked+offline against only the checksum-verified vendor tree, compares exact bytes, then hashes all owned inputs and the full Rust snapshot again
